title: The $230M Question That Defines Cleveland's 2026 Season
description:
The Cleveland Browns face the most important quarterback decision in franchise history, and it might come down to money instead of merit. With Deshaun Watson carrying a $46 million base salary in 2026 after missing two full seasons with Achilles injuries, and Shedeur Sanders—the fifth-round pick who fell from first-round projections—pushing for the starting job, Todd Monken has an impossible choice. We break down the $230 million question that will define the next five years of Browns football, examine the post-Myles Garrett era with Jared Verse stepping in, analyze the roster promotions that signal culture change, and explore whether Cleveland is truly competing in 2026 or already looking ahead to the 2027 draft and Arch Manning. Four days until preseason. Thirty-three years since a division title. One contract that cannot be escaped. This is the Cleveland Browns in 2026.
